name: Prato em Dia — Portal Pro Nutri

meta.source: mobile/prato_em_dia_mobile/lib/app/theme/app_theme.dart (light values exact); dark theme derived for the portal

tokens.name: canvas
tokens.usage: Page background behind the main content area (mobile _canvas).

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Cards, tables, inputs, dialogs — any delimited unit on the canvas.

tokens.name: surface-low
tokens.usage: Sidebar, neutral chips, hovered rows, read-only blocks.

tokens.name: surface-container
tokens.usage: Table header band, neutral status chip fill, skeletons.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Primary text on canvas, surface, surface-low and surface-container (≥11:1 both themes).

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text, metadata, table headers on canvas, surface, surface-low, surface-container (≥4.8:1).

tokens.name: outline
tokens.usage: Input and control borders, unselected radio/checkbox rings (≥4.3:1 on canvas/surface/surface-low).

tokens.name: outline-variant
tokens.usage: Hairlines: card borders (1.5px), table row dividers, sidebar divider. Decorative only.

tokens.name: primary
tokens.usage: The one action colour: primary buttons, selected nav, focus ring, links. As text only on canvas, surface or surface-low.

tokens.name: on-primary
tokens.usage: Text and icons on a primary fill (5.3:1 light, 7.7:1 dark).

tokens.name: primary-container
tokens.usage: Selected nav item, tonal button, 'Vínculo ativo' and 'Publicada' chips.

tokens.name: on-primary-container
tokens.usage: Text and icons on primary-container (≥6.5:1).

tokens.name: secondary
tokens.usage: Food-support clay: meal-group accents, substitution marker icon. As text only on canvas or surface.

tokens.name: secondary-container
tokens.usage: 'Realizada com substituição', 'Alterada' and 'Rascunho' chips; substitution rows.

tokens.name: on-secondary-container
tokens.usage: Text and icons on secondary-container (≥7.5:1).

tokens.name: danger
tokens.usage: Destructive buttons, field errors, 'Falha no envio'. As text on canvas, surface, surface-low.

tokens.name: on-danger
tokens.usage: Text on a danger fill.

tokens.name: danger-container
tokens.usage: Error banner and 'Não realizada' / 'Falha no envio' chip fill.

tokens.name: on-danger-container
tokens.usage: Text and icons on danger-container (≥7:1).

tokens.name: scrim
tokens.usage: Overlay behind confirmation dialogs.

styles.name: display
styles.usage: Login and Início greeting only. Mobile displaySmall.

styles.name: headline
styles.usage: Page title: patient name in PatientHeader, list page titles. Mobile headlineSmall.

styles.name: title
styles.usage: Card and dialog titles, section headings inside a page.

styles.name: subtitle
styles.usage: Meal names, list row primary line. Mobile titleMedium.

styles.name: body-lg
styles.sample: Observações do nutricionista para esta versão.
styles.usage: Form values, prescription notes the patient will read. Mobile bodyLarge.

styles.name: body
styles.usage: Default UI text: table cells, descriptions, metadata. Mobile bodyMedium.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Buttons, nav items, field labels, chips.

styles.name: caption
styles.usage: Hints under fields, timestamps, helper text.

styles.name: overline
styles.usage: Table column headers and small section labels; always uppercase via text-transform.

styles.name: metric
styles.usage: MetricTile values. Use tabular numerals (font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums).

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon-to-text gap inside chips.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Gap between label and field; icon-to-label in buttons and nav.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Chip horizontal padding, gap between stacked fields' hint and next field.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Card padding, input padding (mobile contentPadding), table cell horizontal padding.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Gap between cards in a grid.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Section gap inside a page; sidebar padding.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Main content padding on desktop; gap between page header and content.

tokens.name: space-10
tokens.usage: Empty-state vertical padding.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Table container inner corners, small menus, tooltip.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Buttons, inputs, nav items, alerts (mobile buttons and inputs).

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Cards, metric tiles, dialogs (mobile cardTheme).

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Status chips, tabs indicator, avatar.

tokens.name: border-hairline
tokens.usage: Table row dividers, input borders.

tokens.name: border-card
tokens.usage: Card and metric-tile outline in outline-variant (mobile cardTheme side).

tokens.name: border-focus
tokens.usage: Focus ring and focused input border, in primary.

tokens.name: shadow-overlay
tokens.usage: Dialogs and menus only. Everything on the page is flat: borders, not shadows. In dark, a light 1px ring outlines the panel because a dark shadow barely reads on a dark canvas.

tokens.name: control-height
tokens.usage: Buttons and inputs on desktop (mobile uses 52/48 touch targets).

tokens.name: sidebar-width
tokens.usage: Fixed width of the SideNav on desktop.

tokens.name: content-max
tokens.usage: Max width of the main content column.
